mechanism: Diclofenac may increase cardiovascular strain and blood pressure while lisdexamfetamine (a sympathomimetic amphetamine) elevates heart rate and blood pressure, creating additive cardiovascular effects; additionally, NSAIDs can impair renal function affecting amphetamine clearance.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate closely; consider alternative analgesia (acetaminophen); ensure adequate hydration and renal function monitoring during concurrent use.
